title: Repair and Validate Structured Output
hints: Extraction picks a substring: the first ``` fenced block, else first '{' to LAST '}'. The last brace matters when objects nest.
Try json.loads on the raw candidate first. Only on failure apply the two regex repairs, in order, and try once more.
In Python, isinstance(True, int) is True. Check bool before int and number.
The re-ask carries the original messages, then your model's bad reply as an assistant turn, then the error message. There is at most one re-ask.
